Got a live demo at
UiPath
FUSION 2026 by
Peter Reischer
showing how a large US healthcare payer handles its inbound faxes. Yes, healthcare still runs on fax. Here’s what stood out:

- Full fax workflow, automated. Bots and agents pick up the document, classify it, extract the data, validate it, send it for human review and route it where it needs to go.
- Solution kits for healthcare and life sciences. UiPath now ships complete kits with instructions, so teams start from a working solution instead of assembling every piece themselves.
- Use the coding agent you like. UiPath Autopilot, Claude Code, Codex and Copilot all work, and they’re included with developer licenses.
- Build where you’re comfortable. UiPath Studio or VS Code, your call.

The healthcare kit is what I’d watch. Prebuilt vertical solutions could cut months off getting automation live in heavily regulated industries.

Watch the full demo.

What’s the most manual process still running in your organization?
